name: Pit Fiend

Traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
Traits.text: If the pit fiend fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

Traits.name: Diabolical Restoration
Traits.text: If the pit fiend dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The pit fiend emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 21, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:*  The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:*  The target is immune to this pit fiend's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The pit fiend has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The pit fiend makes one Bite attack, two Devilish Claw attacks, and one Fiery Mace attack. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Oathbound Chains or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Bestow Curse*.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 18 (3d6 + 8) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must make the following saving throw. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 21. *Failure:*  The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target can't regain Hit Points and takes 21 (6d6) Poison damage at the start of each of its turns, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

Actions.name: Devilish Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +14, reach 10 ft. 26 (4d8 + 8) Necrotic damage.

Actions.name: Spellcasting
Actions.text:
The pit fiend casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** *Bestow Curse*, *Suggestion*, *Hold Person*
- **1/Day Each:** *Wall of Fire* (level 5 version)

Actions.name: Oathbound Chains
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 21, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn.
Actions.gmQuote: collects the oaths of dying knights

Actions.name: Hellfire Spellcasting (Recharge 4-6)
Actions.text: The pit fiend casts *Fireball* (level 5 version) twice, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21). It can replace one *Fireball* with *Hold Monster* (level 7 version) or *Wall of Fire*.

lore: Forged in the deep furnaces where broken pacts are smelted down, this pit fiend descends to battlefields to collect the last words of dying knights, hoarding each oath as a link in the chain it wears and one day intends to hang the world from.
